name: HAMMER — Hypothesis Adversarial Mapping, Measurement & Evidence Refinement
mission: Find an observable that separates rival physical theories; attack its assumptions with nuisance models before making an evidence claim.

mandatoryBeforeScientificAcceptance: distinct named AI model identities and genuine provider response IDs
source-specific study packets and depth labels
independent reasoning packets and explicit objections
reproducible measured input with uncertainties and controls
traceable GitHub evidence SHA and reversible decision
reviewProtocol.policy: AI panels may recommend but cannot establish physical truth by agreement. AI role-play is not human professor expertise. No model calls are made by this static site.

designs.title: Born pointer: Everett versus equilibrium Bohm
designs.question: Can the recorded 0/1 outcomes under the ordinary Born measurement class distinguish Everett and Bohmian quantum equilibrium?
caveats: Matched detector settings are paired; crossing configurations in worst-case search is deliberately an overconservative attack, not proof of operational equivalence on its own.
The precise equality in the matched class is separately established by the R012 derivation.

designs.title: Coherence recovery versus stipulated physical loss
designs.question: Would a prespecified recombination outcome separate a nearly unitary recovery model from a specifically irreversible-loss model?
caveats: Assumed bounds are invented design stress tests, not source-measured collapse parameters.
Even a physical-loss exclusion is not a measurement of how many Everett branches are real.

designs.title: The nuisance impostor: false discovery trap
designs.question: Does an apparent distinction survive when a rival theory admits a plausible nuisance configuration that exactly copies the predicted outcomes?

models.label: Toy alternative with unbounded instrumental nuisance

caveats: The exactly matched nuisance case is an intentional counterexample to premature discrimination.
No empirical measurements or nuisance range calibration are provided.
